Prepend a new line and jump to it via command
Expose the commands from the command palette for mobile toolbar buttons
disambiguation: Does not provide any speech to text service itself; it only adds newline commands to the command palette.
extras: The README warns that the plugin does not provide the speech to text service itself.
intentEvidence: As Google Speech to Text Android keyboard does not handle new line command, this plugin makes available such commands
motivation: The author built it because the Google Speech to Text Android keyboard does not handle new line commands.
problem: The Google Speech to Text Android keyboard has no way to insert a new line while dictating into Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Make Google Speech to Text on Android available from the command palette.
relations.plugin: Google Speech to Text Android keyboard

requires.name: Google Speech to Text Android keyboard

summary: Command-palette helper that adds newline commands for dictating with the Google Speech to Text Android keyboard, which cannot insert new lines.
